newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mondragon to focus on tourism business.
newsitem.headline: Mondragon to focus on tourism business.

text.p: Mondragon International Philippines Inc said on Thursday that it will concentrate its business ventures to developing resort and gaming facilities after selling its consumer products business.

"Mondragon International Philippines Inc formally spun off its consumer product business (trading side) in order to focus its activities on the development of resort facilities and gaming (tourism side)," Pierre Paul Buhay, financial services chief, told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
At present, the company, through a subsidiary, operates a hotel, golf and country club, and a casino inside the Clark free port area.

The consumer products division was sold to the Gonzalez family, one of the major Mondragon stockholders. The consumer products division handles direct selling of foreign branded apparel and cosmetics products.
